box.highlights: Glenn 24, Mt. Sinai 21: Michael Kilgannon scored the game-winning touchdown with 7.7 seconds left for Glenn to lead Suffolk IV. Joe Competiello was 13 for 18 with 151 yards and two touchdowns. He also added 120 rushing yards and a touchdown on 17 carries. GJ Cook had five catches for 72 yards and a touchdown. Defensively, Competiello added an interception. Keith King led the defense with 10 tackles and a forced fumble.

Mt. Sinai 42, Port Jefferson 7: Dontae Spadaro rushed for 84 of his team's 240 yards and scored one touchdown to lead Mt. Sinai (1-1) in Suffolk IV. Ethan Arita and Connor Fabian co-led the team with five tackles each. Alex Campanelli and Nicholas Pramataris had interceptions while Brandon Steele, Sean Kit and Ethan Arita recorded sacks. Max Sorentino went 2-for-4 for 54 yards, including a 42-yard touchdown strike to Danny Paolella. For Port Jefferson (0-2), Neko Davis returned a kickoff 80 yards for a touchdown.

Mount Sinai 28, Miller Place 27: Daniel Paolella caught four passes for 109 yards and two touchdowns to lead host Mt. Sinai to a 28-27 win in Suffolk IV football Friday night. He caught a 65-yard TD to give Mount Sinai a 28-21 lead with 5:24 left. Van Johnson scored a 2-yard rushing TD for Miller Place with 2:26 left, but Brandon Steele, Dontae Spadaro and Tommy Massaro combined for the stop on the Panthers' two-point rush attempt. 
Spadaro had 18 carries for 187 yards and a TD. Max Sorrentino completed 10 of 13 passes for 196 yards and two scores and Jackson Rannazzisi added a 30-yard TD run for Mt. Sinai (2-1). 
AJ Rudolph caught touchdown passes of 42 and 38 yards from Shane Kiernan, who also threw a TD pass to Camryn Hardy for Miller Place (2-1).

Babylon 24, Mt. Sinai 7: Aidan Winter had 17 carries for 210 yards and three touchdowns to lead host Babylon (4-0) in Suffolk IV. Winter added a 40-yard reception, two completions for 31 yards and six tackles. Kai Jankow had 15 carries for 141 yards. Zak Vasquez had 14 tackles and Myles Varley added seven tackles. Jake Ostertag and Jankow each had interception. Dontae Spadara ran for a TD for Mt. Sinai (2-2).

Mt. Sinai 31, Kings Park 6: Max Sorrentino threw for 299 yards and three touchdowns to lead host Mt. Sinai (3-2) in Suffolk IV. Daniel Paolella had seven receptions for 189 yards and two scores and a 53-yard rushing score. Dontae Spadaro ran for 193 yards on 18 carries. Nicholas Vaccaro had a 56-yard TD reception and two sacks and Ethan Arita had a sack. Matt Corrado had an 10-yard TD catch for Kings Park (2-3).

Mt. Sinai 35, Center Moriches 13: Daniel Paolella caught two passes from Max Sorrentino for 80 yards and two touchdowns to lead host Mt. Sinai (4-2) in Suffolk IV. Dontae Spadaro had five carries for 89 yards and two TDs and Hunter Pancir added a 35-yard TD run. Jackson Rannazzisi, Nick Pramataris, John Delaney and Paul Frangella each had six tackles. Brandon Smith ran for two touchdowns for Center Moriches (1-5).

Mt. Sinai 16, Bayport-Blue Point 13: Alexander Bottomley kicked the winning 22-yard field goal as time expired in visiting Mt. Sinai's Suffolk IV win. Max Sorrentino ran for the tying 1-yard TD with 1:50 left in the third quarter. Sorrentino completed 13 of 15 passes for 225 yards, including a 70-yard TD pass to Nicholas Vaccaro. Dontae Spadaro ran for 48 yards, caught three passes for 80 yards and blocked a PAT. Ethan Arita had two sacks for Mt. Sinai (5-2). 
Colin Reyer had 34 carries for 209 yards and a touchdown for Bayport-Blue Point (5-2). Colin Clark completed three passes for 80 yards, including a 22-yard TD pass to Colin Most.

Mt. Sinai 26, Hampton Bays 6: Dontae Spadaro had eight carries for 175 yards and two touchdowns, including an 81-yard TD run to lead host Mt. Sinai (6-2) in Suffolk IV. Hunter Pancir had a 70-yard TD run and Vincent Graziano ran for an 18-yard TD. Brayden Talmage ran for a 15-yard score for Hampton Bays (2-6).

Mount Sinai 59, Shoreham-Wading River 34: Dontae Spadaro had 32 carries for 361 yards and three touchdowns to lead host Mt. Sinai (7-2) in Suffolk IV. Hunter Pancir had seven carries for 72 yards and two TDs. Connor Fabian and Vincent Graziano each added a rushing score. Daniel Paolella and Alex Campanelli each caught a TD pass from Max Sorrentino. Leonardo Mattera had an interception. Noah Gregorek ran for a touchdown and threw TD passes of 8, 24 and 54 yards to Collin Abrams for Shoreham-Wading River, which finished 3-6. Bland added a 93-yard kickoff return for a TD.

Bayport-Blue Point 23, Mt. Sinai 7: Collin Reyer had 22 carries for 100 yards and two touchdowns to lead visiting No. 3 Bayport-Blue Point over No. 2 Mt. Sinai in the Suffolk Division IV semifinals. Tommy Steyert made three field goals and two PATs and kicked four touchbacks. Colin Clark had 27 carries for 159 yards and added 48 passing yards. Brayden Waldbauer caught three passes for 28 yards. Bayport-Blue Point (8-2) will face No. 1 Babylon in the final at 4 p.m. on Friday at Stony Brook University.
Dontae Spadaro ran for a 5-yard TD on the game's opening drive for Mt. Sinai, which finished 7-3.
